newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's sees higher yr net profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's sees higher yr net profit.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday that it was on track to exceed the 1995/96 net profit despite seeing higher interest and tax expenses in the current year.

"Our objective is to seek to do better than we did last year, notwithstanding that we will have higher interest costs, because of the acquisitions, and also we will have higher tax," chairman John Ralph told reporters after the annual meeting.
Asked if the company was on track to meeting this objective, Ralph said: "Yes, I don't think there is any reason we won't, but it will be a tough task."
Foster's, Australia's leading brewer, achieved a 2.0 percent rise in 1995/96 (July/June) net profit to A$293.3 million.
The company acquired local wine producer Mildara Blass last financial year, with the unit contributing A$16 million in 1995/96 earnings before interest and tax.
